title: Chaplain Retreat Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4800  633 CONS PKP
description_text: The 633d Contracting Squadron is seeking information from certified woman-owned small businesses (WOSBs) that can provide Chaplain Retreat Services. The purpose of this sources sought notice is to determine the availability of capable vendors who can plan, coordinate, and conduct retreats tailored to the professional development and well-being of Airmen. Services may include venue coordination, program development, facilitator support, meals, and any necessary materials or resources for retreat participants. Interested businesses should have prior experience in organizing retreats or similar events for spiritual or professional support staff. We encourage all qualified WOSBs with relevant experience to respond and provide information regarding their capabilities. This notice is for market research purposes only and is not a solicitation or request for quote.
